concept: Being kind to someone even if they're different from you or not part of your usual group
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character is kind to someone who seems different or is left out, and discovers something nice about them
exercise.reflection_prompt: What did the character discover by being kind instead of staying distant?
exercise.practice: Student names someone they could be kinder to, even if they don't know them well

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific act of kindness, not just a general good feeling
